The latest DeepSeek release just turned the efficiency dial up to 11.

- DeepSeek‑V4.1‑Flash‑1017 swaps the classic attention kernel for Flash Attention 2, cutting VRAM usage by up to 40 % while keeping latency under 30 ms on a single A100.  
- The checkpoint size stays the same, so the model’s capabilities haven’t been trimmed—only the cost of running them. That makes fine‑tuning and serving on modest hardware a realistic option for more teams.  
- Because DeepSeek keeps the weights fully open, the community can now experiment with high‑throughput inference without waiting for a cloud provider’s premium tier.

I’m curious: if you could run a 30‑billion‑parameter model on a single GPU, what new applications would you prototype first?
